_note: Where Tempovision looks for assets. Licences are summaries to route the search, not legal advice: open each item's page, read its licence, and record it with `tempovision assets add/fetch`. Reviewed 2026-11. Add sources the artist trusts.

fonts.name: Google Fonts
fonts.notes: Broad and reliable; check the family's licence file. Variable fonts available for many families.

fonts.name: Fontshare (Indian Type Foundry)
fonts.notes: High-quality grotesks and display faces (e.g. Satoshi, Clash, General Sans). Read the ITF FFL for redistribution limits: embed in renders, do not redistribute files.

fonts.name: Collletttivo
fonts.notes: Libre display typefaces with strong character.

fonts.name: Uncut.wtf
fonts.notes: A catalogue of free contemporary typefaces; check each font's licence.

fonts.name: Fontsource
fonts.notes: Self-hostable packages of open fonts (npm @fontsource/*), handy for Remotion.

footage.name: Pexels Videos
footage.notes: Good 4K stock; avoid identifiable people/brands for commercial work unless released.

footage.name: Pixabay Videos
footage.notes: Free key at https://pixabay.com/api/docs/. Many clips in 4K, most at least 1080p. Same care as any stock for identifiable people and brands.

footage.name: Mixkit
footage.notes: Read the per-category licence (music video use is generally covered; not for redistribution as stock).

footage.name: Internet Archive: Prelinger Archives
footage.license: mostly public domain; some CC; check each item
footage.notes: Mid-century ephemeral films: the classic film-collage source.

footage.name: NASA Image and Video Library
footage.license: generally not copyrighted (US gov); NASA logos and identifiable astronauts have rules
footage.notes: Space, Earth, launches; check the item for third-party material.

footage.name: Wikimedia Commons (video)
footage.license: per file (CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA, PD)

footage.name: Artist's own footage
footage.notes: Always ask in the interview: phone clips, rehearsals, places from the song.

images.name: Openverse
images.license: CC and public domain, per item
images.notes: Search across Flickr, Wikimedia, museums; filter license_type=commercial.

images.name: Pixabay Images
images.notes: Photos, illustrations and vectors. The API's download URL is capped at 1280 px; for a full-resolution hero image, download it from the item's page.

images.name: Art Institute of Chicago
images.notes: IIIF images up to full resolution.

images.name: Rijksmuseum
images.license: public domain (CC0) for most collection images

images.name: Smithsonian Open Access
images.license: CC0 for items marked Open Access

images.name: Library of Congress
images.license: free to use sets; others vary

textures_3d.name: ambientCG
textures_3d.notes: PBR materials: paper, concrete, fabric, metal.

textures_3d.name: Kenney
textures_3d.notes: Game-style 2D/3D asset packs; useful for stylised worlds.

textures_3d.name: Procedural (in engine)
textures_3d.notes: Paper fibre, grain, halftone, noise fields, gradients: write them as shaders/SVG filters; no licence questions, exactly on spec.

motion.name: LottieFiles (free animations)
motion.notes: Icons and small motion pieces; rarely right as hero material.

motion.name: HyperFrames registry
motion.notes: `npx hyperframes catalog` / `/hyperframes-registry`: captions, transitions, effects to restyle.

motion.name: Shadertoy
motion.license: default CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 unless the author states otherwise
motion.notes: Study, do not paste into a commercial release. Write your own shader instead.

sfx.name: Freesound
sfx.license: per sound: CC0, CC BY, CC BY-NC
sfx.notes: Only used when the brief asks for sound design beyond the master.

generation.name: fal (MCP)
generation.notes: search_models / recommend_model / get_pricing / run_model / submit_job + check_job / upload_file. Images, image-to-video, upscaling, background removal. Quote prices before batches.

generation.name: Local ComfyUI
generation.notes: If the artist already runs it with a GPU; check each model's licence (some are non-commercial).

references_and_learning.name: Art of the Title
references_and_learning.notes: Title-sequence craft: how type carries a film.

references_and_learning.name: Fonts In Use
references_and_learning.notes: Typefaces on records, posters and film.
